name: Adds a user as a student of a course.
description: Adds a user as a student of a course. Adds a user as a student of a course. POST /v1/courses/{courseId}/students
context:
POST /v1/courses/{courseId}/students
Adds a user as a student of a course. Domain administrators are permitted to [directly add](https://developers.google.com/workspace/classroom/guides/manage-users) users within their domain as students to courses within their domain. Students are permitted to add themselves to a course using an enrollment code. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to create students in this course or for access errors. * `NOT_FOUND` if the requested course ID does not exist. * `FAILED_PRECONDITION` if the requested user's account is disabled, for the following request errors: * CourseMemberLimitReached * CourseNotModifiable * UserGroupsMembershipLimitReached * InactiveCourseOwner * `ALREADY_EXISTS` if the user is already a student or teacher in the course.
Required: courseId (path) — Identifier of the course to create the student in. This identifier can be either the Classroom-assigned identifier or an alias.; body (body)
Optional: enrollmentCode (query) — Enrollment code of the course to create the student in. This code is required if userId corresponds to the requesting user; it may be omitted if the requesting user has administrative permissions to create students for any user.; fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.

name: Deletes a student of a course.
description: Deletes a student of a course. Deletes a student of a course. DELETE /v1/courses/{courseId}/students/{userId}
context:
DELETE /v1/courses/{courseId}/students/{userId}
Deletes a student of a course. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to delete students of this course or for access errors. * `NOT_FOUND` if no student of this course has the requested ID or if the course does not exist.
Required: courseId (path) — Identifier of the course. This identifier can be either the Classroom-assigned identifier or an alias.; userId (path) — Identifier of the student to delete. The identifier can be one of the following: * the numeric identifier for the user * the email address of the user * the string literal `"me"`, indicating the requesting user
Optional: fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.

Returns a student of a course. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to view students of this course or for access errors. * `NOT_FOUND` if no student of this course has the requested ID or if the course does not exist.
Required: userId (path) — Identifier of the student to return. The identifier can be one of the following: * the numeric identifier for the user * the email address of the user * the string literal `"me"`, indicating the requesting user; courseId (path) — Identifier of the course. This identifier can be either the Classroom-assigned identifier or an alias.
Optional: fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.

GET /v1/courses/{courseId}/students
Returns a list of students of this course that the requester is permitted to view. This method returns the following error codes: * `NOT_FOUND` if the course does not exist. * `PERMISSION_DENIED` for access errors.
Required: courseId (path) — Identifier of the course. This identifier can be either the Classroom-assigned identifier or an alias.
Optional: pageToken (query) — nextPageToken value returned from a previous list call, indicating that the subsequent page of results should be returned. The list request must be otherwise identical to the one that resulted in this token.; pageSize (query) — Maximum number of items to return. The default is 30 if unspecified or `0`. The server may return fewer than the specified number of results.; fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.
